HighamBench.p15_t3_low_rank_matmul_error {b r : ℕ} (run : HighamBench.P15LowRankMatMulExecution b r) :
  have Atilde := HighamBench.p15LowRankMatrix run.XA run.YA;
  have Btilde := HighamBench.p15LowRankMatrix run.YB run.XB;
  have gammaC := HighamBench.p15GammaReal (HighamBench.p15LowRankMatMulCost b r) run.unitRoundoff;
  HighamBench.p15FrobNorm (run.trace.result - HighamBench.p15MatMul Atilde Btilde) ≤
      gammaC * HighamBench.p15FrobNorm Atilde * HighamBench.p15FrobNorm Btilde ∧
    HighamBench.p15FrobNorm (run.trace.result - HighamBench.p15MatMul run.A run.B) ≤
      gammaC * HighamBench.p15FrobNorm run.A * HighamBench.p15FrobNorm run.B +
        run.epsilon * (1 + gammaC) *
          (run.betaA * HighamBench.p15FrobNorm run.B + HighamBench.p15FrobNorm run.A * run.betaB +
            run.epsilon * run.betaA * run.betaB)
'HighamBench.p15_t3_low_rank_matmul_error' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
